registration.method: 2025派出所规划核实PDF第3页实际建设位置图、第9页实建照片，2025一期控规正文确认A-29-01。1335×1888参考图按三个可读建筑角点坐标仿射校准，楼翼与庭院线人工近似提取，13.8/10.2米为图注；低区5.5米暂沿报建图估算。全园仍按地块关系锚定，不表示完成投影坐标配准，室内未建。

limitations: Building dimensions are estimates; this is not a planning-compliance review. Parcel redline and building outlines are approximate image traces, calibrated with three building corner coordinates; global CRS is not registered.
sourcePrecision: Three readable building corners calibrate approximate image tracing; ground-level courtyard positions checked, interiors not modelled.
